bio.text: Yvette Clarke represents New York's 9th Congressional District in the U.S. House of Representatives and has been in Congress since 2007.
Before Congress she served on the New York City Council, representing the 40th District, succeeding her mother, Una S. T. Clarke.
She is a daughter of Jamaican immigrants, comes from central Brooklyn, and is a graduate of Oberlin College.
